entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `word` TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE, `meaning` TEXT NOT NULL, `addedAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `reviewAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `memoryStage` INTEGER NOT NULL, `mastered` INTEGER NOT NULL)

indices.name: index_words_word
indices.createSql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_words_word` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`word`)

indices.name: index_words_mastered_reviewAt
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_words_mastered_reviewAt` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`mastered`, `reviewAt`)

indices.name: index_words_addedAt
indices.createSql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_words_addedAt` ON `${TABLE_NAME}` (`addedAt`)
